newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes low on dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee, which opened a touch firmer against the dollar, closed lower on import covering demand for the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.12 after opening at 57.07. The currency closed at 57.08 on Thursday.
"The exchange rate moved in a very narrow range, and the supply of dollars was very tight," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
The dollar-rupee exchange rate moved between 57.10 and 57.12, which was the Central Bank selling limit, sending banks to the authorities for dollars to cover imports, he said.
Central Bank buying and selling rates were fixed at 55.9919 and 57.1231.
Overnight call money which was volatile, closed at 18 percent after moving between between 21 and 16 percent, dealers said.
